description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to blacklisted emails within the Coocook schema. It includes methods for adding emails to the blacklist and checking if an email is okay, along with some configuration for the blacklist type and columns.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistEmail
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted emails within the Coocook schema, extending the base ResultSet and including specific methods for email blacklist management.

methods.name: add_email
methods.description: Adds a literal email address to the blacklist.

methods.name: is_email_ok
methods.description: Checks if the provided email address is not blacklisted, referencing the Blacklist component.
